question: On the user-fixed 512x4 network, how do discount horizon and GAE lambda jointly affect absolute one-hour completion under the best optimizer recipe from the predeclared twelve-arm development search?
source_recipe_rule: Use ranking.order[0] across ALL twelve arms, including reference_512x4 if first. Validate full ranking before materialization. Inherit the corresponding complete effective config from the original frozen design; do not use confirmation outcomes or final banks to choose this recipe.
freeze_rule: Materialize all four complete configs, exact source arm/hash, seed allocation, ranking/evaluation and policy map in SQLite before opening opt512x4 confirmation final bank 98001/98002. New source snapshot frozen before launch.
launch_rule: After opt512x4 confirmation has finished, automatically start if full job/evaluation/reporting reservations fit <=15 round core-hours, <=72 extension core-hours and the 20:00 cutoff. No further approval/tick needed. No concurrent competing runner.
temporary_controls: Every other effective source recipe parameter, with fresh seeds, fresh weights/optimizer and full 60-minute endpoints. Preserve all reward gates, observation, PPO, optimizer, task semantics and evaluation; list values explicitly.

evaluation.evaluation.checkpoint: endpoint model.pt (eval_every 0: no periodic test, no checkpoint selection)
evaluation.evaluation.completion_definition: the game's level-complete event fired during the episode (evaluate.classify_outcome 'clear'); deaths or timeouts in the countdown after the last kill are not clears
evaluation.evaluation.metric: completed clears per 990 episodes (99 levels x 10 episodes)

ranking: mean absolute completed fraction on development bank descending
selection: After all twelve full endpoints and all development evaluations, freeze highest-ranked non-reference configuration and its three endpoint hashes plus reference hashes before opening final banks. Reference remains visible even if it ranks first.
interpretation: Absolute outcomes and all policy-seed/per-level results. Local matched 2x2 evidence, not global optimum or a calibrated significance claim. No fixed +30 replacement threshold. Three independently trained policies per arm; evaluation episodes are not additional training replicas. Final-bank result is not used to switch candidates.

budget.retry: at most one infrastructure retry if the full remaining budget/deadline reservation fits; never performance-based

required_prelaunch_checks: source ranking validation passed and source recipe deterministically matches ranking.order[0]
all four arms differ only in gamma and gae_lambda plus matched seed
complete configs and both factor domain types/tested value sets stored in SQLite, reciprocal MLflow links ready
new seeds have no collision with existing runs/evaluation records/pending reservations
full program-extension and deadline budget fits including preflight abandoned-root allocation
current implemented GAE accepts exact gamma/lambda values without changing finite-horizon termination semantics
seed_check: At specification time none of 8001–8003 occur as SQLite training seeds and none of 90001/90002/100001/100002 occur as registered evaluation seeds. Recheck pending reservations before registering.
